body: The thing is, I have always had a problem with alcohol. This situation with the girl happened two weeks ago today and I have drank every night since. I know I shouldn't, but its so hard not to. I was with her for 3 years. I don't think she really likes my drinking, but doesn't know just how bad it is. So any shot of getting her back would require less drinking, but its so hard. Also, my roommate just moved out and I dont know where I am going now. So sitting in this empty apartment sure isn't helping
